decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008155 (RIVERSIDE APPAREL, MER-000051, card CRD-000047) posted on 2026-10-14, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 15 days later. The limit is 120 days (time-limits). Its authorisation AUTH-008340 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, no PIN and the fraud flag set. The card was not present, the payment was not authenticated and the fraud flag is set, so under unauthorised-card-not-present the payment counts as unauthorised. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant; TXN-008155 is the only one. The credit is the posted amount of 1,743.28 EUR, which is under the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit (provisional-credit). The cardholder claims 2,004.77 EUR to cover bank charges and their own costs. That larger claim does not change the credit: policy never credits more than the disputed transaction amount.
